MiMo-V2.6-RL General (Harbor)

FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-general

Complete a brief inside a simulated company by working through 5 to 15 business systems served over MCP.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • long-horizon workplace agents
  • MCP tool-use RL

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Not stated

The task's verifier grades the outcome with rule checks plus an LLM judge (Inkling).

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

hf download FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-general --repo-type dataset --local-dir mimo-general
cd mimo-general
PYTHONPATH=agents HF_TOKEN=hf_... harbor run -y -c jobs/general.yaml

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-general --repo-type dataset --local-dir MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-general

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-general --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

4. Serve it for training with OpenEnvcommon pattern, not from this card

pip install "openenv[harbor]"
openenv harbor serve --dataset FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-general --llm-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 --model <your-model>

Framework documentation: Harbor, OpenEnv. Needs: HF token; LLM judge access; Docker or Daytona sandbox.
